name: Peppermint
description: Open source ticketing and help desk platform for support teams and issue tracking.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://peppermint:{{env.DB_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/peppermint"
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET: {{env.SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/uploads:/app/uploads
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: peppermint
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: peppermint
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
